title: Provincie Flevoland GeoServer WMS
note: The province's external GeoServer: environment, land use, nature and infrastructure. Its capabilities document advertises far more than the two layers the atlas import carried. Its capabilities document advertises only EPSG:28992 (in 1.3.0, also CRS:84), yet GetMap with SRS=EPSG:3857 returns tiles — verified 2026-09-06 against MI_WINDTURBINES — so no CRS filter is applied here; filtering on the advertised list would drop all 274 layers.
